Screen Seijas 2019 for book-review status; PNAS In This Issue is a summary requiring underlying research. Erratum is not an independent study; Chard publication year requires checking.
Anatolia/Levant/Mesopotamia and Asian transport studies are comparative context, not direct evidence of ancient American trade.
Experimental reed-boat voyage does not establish prehistoric transatlantic contact. Preserve the claim as an unverified lead, not a mapped route.
Baño Nuevo 1 narrative and table give different temporal scopes; recover specimen-specific ages rather than assuming continuous 11000-year exchange.
Consensus percentage is search-result metadata, not measured scholarly agreement or a probability. Figure captions are retained; no actual figures or reuse license were supplied.

Check overlap between Sanger 2018 and 2019 datasets; shared specimens or sites are not independent corroboration.

reviewNotes: Keep disputed deep occupation dates separate from later sampled genomes. Early Holocene ancestry evidence cannot independently verify a 20000–40000 BP occupation or direct descent from its unidentified occupants.

Cranial morphology is not a genetic lineage or an ethnic identity. Historical racial typology terms belong only in attributed historiographic context, not current population labels.
Highest outgroup f3 among sampled comparison groups is shared genetic drift, not proof of exclusive direct descent, unchanged culture or ancient language.

Candidate site records: Gruta Azul de Cocalinho separate early and later phases, Lapa do Santo, Cerca Grande, Santana do Riacho, Capelinha and Toca dos Coqueiros. Regional Lagoa Santa duration is not continuous residence at all constituent sites.
Check duplicate Menendez 2021/2022 versions and multiple Boeda publications for shared evidence; reused specimens are not independent confirmations.

Dental morphology is not genome sequencing; preserve Andrea study method and check full author metadata.
Steere 1996 may be a review of an Arenal volume; verify source type and original research. Carmack late Postclassic framework does not date all chiefdom origins.

Candidate individually dated sites/landscapes: Finca Guardiria, Jicaro, G-995 La Chiripa, Laguna Arancibia and specific Arenal sites. Lake sediment proxies are regional context, not settlement population estimates.
Brazil, Mapuche and Ohlone papers are comparative context rather than direct Costa Rican evidence. Preserve caption but no figure file/license supplied.

Deduplicate repeated Ardelean entries; papers and responses on one site are not independent settlements or independent dating datasets.

Barquera 2024 Chichen Itza to contemporary regional affinity concerns sampled populations and much later chronology than Hoyo Negro. Preserve colonial admixture and immunity findings without claiming unchanged genomes.

Kennett 2022 greater than 50 percent ancestry result refers to sampled Belize individuals. Do not extend the percentage to all southeastern Mesoamerica or transfer sample dates to Honduran or Mexican sites.

Garcia-Ortiz modeled divergence estimates from present-day samples are not direct settlement dates or proof agriculture caused divergence. Modern sample locations are not ancient settlement coordinates.

Copan belongs in Honduras; supplied Murray table labels Mexico. Verify original geographic scope, gene flow and demographic estimates; do not substitute effective population size for city inhabitants.
Villa-Islas central/northern Mexico and Nakatsuka California/northwestern Mexico are separate regional evidence, not proof of local southern continuity.
Llamas and Battaglia genetic models do not directly date cave inundation. Battaglia summary attributing first peopling to agriculture and great empires requires correction from original source.

Final Gonzalez 2003 title paired with Santa Marta environmental takeaway may be a mismatched citation; verify before using as site evidence. Named Chiapas cave claims need identifiable original sources.
Preserve morphological hypotheses as attributed interpretations rather than genetic proof. Figure captions are archived but figures and reuse permissions were not supplied.

Angi burial is contextually dated, not directly dated from collagen.

Artifact provenance and modeled routes do not establish exact voyages or universal trade-language-war causal chains.
Bird DNA is not human ancestry. Belarus/European/Asian comparison studies do not establish American local events.
Genetic turnover does not independently identify warfare; ancestry, language and identity remain separate.
Survey totals are not population sizes or contemporaneous settlement counts. No precise coordinates, populations or language assignments invented.
